reads.note: Jira v1 issue getAll with limit 10 and a JQL option: POST /rest/api/2/search {jql, maxResults: 10} (v2, so description is a plain string, which Simplify Thread For AI needs). Atlassian retired /rest/api/2/search on Cloud in 2025; whether n8n 2.47.7 calls /search or /search/jql is unverified, so both are answered. The Jira domain comes from the credential: the bench credential must set domain https://acme-support.atlassian.net
issueComment getAll per issue (runs once per sub-execution): GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment on Cloud, bodies in ADF, which Simplify Thread For AI walks (body.content[].content[].text)
agent tool: same search endpoint as the list, told apart by the JQL in the body (text ~ "<title>" AND status IN ("In Progress", "Done")); the title is model-chosen
agent tool: Notion v2.2 search, limit 4: POST /v1/search {query, page_size}; the query is model-chosen. Only titles come back (simplified), as from the connector

branches: Get Issue Metadata: DateTime.fromISO('not-a-date') formats as 'Invalid DateTime' for SUP-4131
Simplify Thread For AI is expected to fail on SUP-4130: description.replaceAll of null, and the rule node has no content array
SUP-4131's empty paragraph renders an empty message; classification is model-driven
